concerns.text: US-2 specifies that 'If a binary classification task is performed... the system MUST also report F1-score', but there is no corresponding Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) that mandates the implementation of a classification path or the reporting of the F1-score. FR-003 only specifies a 'Random Forest regressor'.

US-1 and the Edge Cases section specify that the system MUST 'filter for entries with valid labels OR critical cooling rates' and 'exclude [undefined labels]', but no FR explicitly mandates this filtering/exclusion logic. FR-001 refers to a 'curated' dataset, which contradicts the US requirement that the system perform the filtering.

The Edge Cases section specifies that if the data source returns an empty dataset, 'The system MUST fail gracefully with a specific error message', but this requirement is not backed by any Functional Requirement (FR).
